phase: Phase 2.111 Natural-language Import / MVP Closeout Gap Closure Pack

acceptance_items.name: Natural-language import intent detection

acceptance_items.name: Runtime hook before normal retrieval / answer
acceptance_items.phase2_requirement: Import intent must be intercepted before ordinary retrieval
acceptance_items.required_next_action: Preserve evidence that failed imports do not fall through into retrieval answers.

acceptance_items.name: Real upload client path

acceptance_items.name: Feature flag / explicit authorization gate
acceptance_items.phase2_requirement: Real import must require explicit authorization

acceptance_items.name: Document ID / version ID / chunk count / index count returned after real import
acceptance_items.phase2_requirement: Import must return verifiable document/version/index metadata
missing_evidence: current accepted closeout run record with document_id version_id chunk_count indexed_count
acceptance_items.required_next_action: Capture sanitized metadata fields in a future accepted smoke.

acceptance_items.name: Same-session alias persistence

missing_evidence: current accepted closeout smoke proving same-session alias persistence
acceptance_items.required_next_action: Future smoke must bind alias after import and reuse it in the same session.

acceptance_items.name: Follow-up retrieval from imported document with citation
acceptance_items.phase2_requirement: Imported document must support citation-backed retrieval
missing_evidence: current accepted follow-up retrieval evidence using the imported alias
citation visible in accepted smoke output

missing_evidence: current accepted smoke showing returned_document_ids only include imported document
acceptance_items.required_next_action: Future smoke must record returned_document_ids and third-document contamination status.

acceptance_items.name: Missing Evidence when parser / permission / evidence is absent

missing_evidence: accepted closeout smoke or dry-run record showing failure boundary on unavailable parser/permission/evidence
acceptance_items.required_next_action: Future smoke should include explicit stop conditions; user may accept boundary docs without executing negative cases.

acceptance_items.name: No raw path / secret / raw row / customer data output
acceptance_items.phase2_requirement: Natural import evidence must remain sanitized
acceptance_items.required_next_action: Future smoke must report sanitized fields only.

acceptance_items.name: Mac mini operator checklist readiness

acceptance_items.name: Evidence template / ignored sanitized run record readiness

Go/Pause/No-Go report for the natural-language import flow
